```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
cameras = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a violin plot for sensor type distribution
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.set_style('whitegrid')
sns.violinplot(x='sensor_type', y='megapixels', data=cameras, hue='brand', split=True)
plt.title('Sensor Type Distribution (Megapixels)')
plt.xlabel('Sensor Type')
plt.ylabel('Megapixels')
plt.legend(title='Brand')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
